Selected work

PallorHb

Anaemia screening from photographs of the eyelid, and an audit of the benchmark it is tested on

Preprint on Zenodo, September 2026. Sole author.

I set out to estimate haemoglobin from conjunctiva photographs on the public CP-AnemiC dataset. Its 710 published records turned out to be 383 distinct photographs. The copies cross hospitals and carry conflicting haemoglobin values, so grouping folds by site, the standard safeguard, still left two-fifths of the inflation in place.

Read the preprintCode and duplicate detector

Python, scikit-learn, NumPy, SciPy

Distinct photographs
383 of 710 records
Inflation from a naive split
+0.176 AUROC (95% CI +0.120 to +0.232)
Corrected baseline
AUROC 0.706 (95% CI 0.653 to 0.757)
What the image adds
+0.182 AUROC over demographics alone (DeLong p = 2 × 10⁻⁶)
Limit
A triage screen, not a haemoglobin meter: Bland-Altman limits of agreement span 7.8 g/dL
Reproducibility
62 tests. Every number in the manuscript is regenerated and checked by script.

PURSUIT-1

A 92 mm quadcopter whose circuit board is its own airframe, built to follow one enrolled person

Rev A board built and bench-tested. Not yet flown.

There is no separate frame. The 4-layer board is the structure, and the motors clamp into rings at the ends of its arms. The board is generated from a Python netlist. The flight firmware runs on an ESP32-S3 and is written from the IMU registers up. Detection and identity run on a laptop, which sends setpoints over WiFi.

Code, board files and bring-up log

KiCad and its Python API, ngspice, C++, PlatformIO, Python, ONNX Runtime, OpenCV

Boards
Rev A fabricated and brought up on the bench, August 2026. Rev C released for fabrication.
Link
0 corrupt in 3,828 command and 2,551 telemetry packets, with the control loop at about 1.09 kHz
Identity
0 false accepts in 24,110 impostor faces. Held lock on 391 of 400 frames with a second person in view, and never transferred.
Stability
Uncompensated, the vision loop goes unstable at about 17 ms of delay, and the measured round trip is 20 ms. With attitude compensation it settles past 200 ms, in simulation.
Caught on the bench
The IMU sat 180 degrees out in yaw, which would have flipped the aircraft on take-off. The host tests had passed on synthetic data.
Tests
369: 128 firmware, 227 vision, 14 flight simulation
Next
Measure hover throttle on a scale, tune each axis with the aircraft restrained, then hover at 1 m

Wave Lab

A real-time harmonic analyser that runs in the browser

Live at paingheinhtet.com since June 2026. Demo mode needs no microphone.

A single-page instrument that takes the microphone signal and shows what it is made of while it plays: each dominant frequency drawn as its own travelling sine wave with its note name, the spectrum with its peaks marked, the raw waveform, an X-Y phase scope, and the detected sines re-summed and laid over the real wave. The analysis runs on an 8,192-point FFT in the Web Audio API; the overlay uses a direct DFT at each detected frequency, so amplitude and phase are exact rather than read off a bin. Low-, high- and band-pass filters apply live, with optional monitoring. A YAMNet classifier runs in the browser through TensorFlow.js and names the sound among 521 classes; song recognition goes through the AudD API with the user's own token, which never leaves the browser.

Open the instrument (demo mode)Code

JavaScript, Web Audio API, Canvas, TensorFlow.js

Analysis frame
8,192-point FFT: 5.9 Hz per bin and 171 ms of audio per frame at 48 kHz, smoothing 0.78
Decomposition
The strongest peaks (5 by default, adjustable) each traced as a travelling sine; phase and amplitude from a direct DFT at the detected frequency
Measurements
Level and peak in dB, fundamental with note name, period, wavelength in air at 343 m/s, spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate, harmonics H1 to H8
Filters
Low-, high- and band-pass biquad stages with a live cutoff; Q 0.7, band-pass Q 4
Classifier
YAMNet, 521 AudioSet classes, running client-side in TensorFlow.js; no server and no API call
Size
One HTML file of about 800 lines, no build step, no dependencies beyond TensorFlow.js. MIT licence.
Also
A desktop version in Python (matplotlib) with a Laplace s-plane view, and a Colab notebook

EIT-16CH

A 16-electrode electrical impedance tomography instrument, and how to reconstruct images from it

Simulation only. Boards designed, nothing powered yet.

EIT images a cross-section from voltages measured at the surface. It is the method used at the bedside to watch a lung inflate. My first learned reconstruction, trained on clean simulations, lost to the classical Gauss-Newton solver as soon as noise was added. Trained with the noise model the instrument will actually have, a small U-Net beat it at every noise level tested.

KiCad, ESP32-S3, PlatformIO, PyTorch, NumPy, pyEIT

At 20 dB
Correlation with the truth 0.566, against 0.170 for Gauss-Newton
Clean data
0.825 against 0.791
Uncertainty
Five-member ensemble: the confident half of each image is 8 to 18 times more accurate than the doubtful half
Hardware
A 4-layer 100 x 100 mm board with 104 footprints, and a 2-layer through-hole version for hand assembly. Neither is fabricated.
Next
Measure the real signal-to-noise ratio in a saline tank and test the simulation-trained model against it

TT-Scout

Table tennis match analysis from one phone on a tripod

Checked by hand against real match video.

Film a match from the side of the table. TT-Scout finds every point and who won it, keeps the score, and measures each shot's speed in 3D with its own error bar. The table is the calibration: it is exactly 2.74 by 1.525 m, so its four corners recover where the phone stood. Ball tracking is classical, so when it goes wrong you can find the frame and see why.

CodeOpen an example report

Python, OpenCV, NumPy, PyTorch, Apple Vision

Point winners
Correct on all 21 endings that could be judged by eye: 16 of 16 on the recording the rules were tuned on, 5 of 5 checked blind on another
Shot speed
Median error 3% on simulated shots with noise, spin and hidden contacts. Not yet measured against a real ball.
Table found automatically
8 of 8 own recordings, 12 of 12 OpenTTGames clips
Learned detector, research only
Finds the ball in 98% of labelled frames against 77% for the classical detector, on 7 held-out clips

Hardware

EMG front end

Surface-EMG amplifier and RP2040 firmware for proportional grip control

Board built, telemetry verified. No EMG recorded yet.

An instrumentation amplifier with driven-right-leg mains rejection feeds a Raspberry Pi Pico, which runs the whole loop: filtering, a safety state machine, and a map from contraction strength to grip. In a 10 s capture the link delivered 499 frames with no CRC errors and none dropped. The analog stage has not been powered, so nothing has been recorded from skin.

Code and board files

KiCad, C++, PlatformIO, Python

RL Car

Uncertainty-aware autonomous racing

Simulation only. The car is not built.

A racer meant to slow down when it stops trusting a sensor. The useful result was negative: an ensemble over the policy scored AUROC 0.127 on a blinded sensor, worse than chance, because steering has many right answers and disagreement between them means nothing. Estimating it on a forward model and isolating the faulty sensor, instead of braking, cut crashes from 155 to 2 across 192 held-out fault episodes at full speed. The body aerodynamics use a Navier-Stokes solver written from scratch and validated against published cylinder-flow benchmarks.

Python, NumPy, SciPy, OpenSCAD, FreeCAD, gmsh, CalculiX

Photobioreactor controller

ESP32-S3 controller for a 1 L algae culture

Simulation only. Board designed, not fabricated.

A 2-layer board that reads optical density, pH and temperature and switches the lights, air and dosing. A fitted growth model chooses the light schedule. Across ten simulated runs with unknown parameters it grew a median of 21% more biomass than a fixed timer at equal energy, and never less.

KiCad, ngspice, CadQuery, Python, PlatformIO

Watch Sentinel

Illness early-warning from Apple Watch data

Validated on synthetic data only.

Resting heart rate, heart rate variability, respiratory rate and wrist temperature are each scored against a personal 28-day baseline that never sees the future, and three of the four must agree before it alerts. A SwiftUI app exports the data from HealthKit. It compiles but has not yet run on a device.

Code

Python, pandas, Swift, HealthKit

Gripper

Control software for a 4-DOF robot arm

100 unit tests pass. Not yet run on the arm.

Two modes, switched by a hand gesture: teleoperation that follows a tracked hand, and a grasp that aligns to an object by visual servoing. A Raspberry Pi 5 does perception and planning. An ESP32 does servo control and safety, so the arm stops if the Python side hangs or the cable is pulled.

Code

Python, MediaPipe, C++, ESP32

Kaggriculture

Market-timing layers for Kaggle's two-farm simulation competition

Rank 339 of 10,246 on the public leaderboard at the close, 30 September 2026. Final standing settles in mid-October.

Two farms sell into one market where the price is a fixed function of stock and orders are served slot by slot, so the position of an order in the list is worth money. Most rivals in my band ran the same public engine, so I could predict their list, check that prediction every turn against their public money, and place each of my sales one slot ahead of theirs. When a rival buys a block of wheat, a layer buys alongside it and sells in the last slot of the same turn, taking the rise the rival's own purchase causes. Every build was replayed into my seat of a few hundred recorded ladder games and had to win at least as many; the farm itself is the public 2965 Master Engine (Apache-2.0), unchanged except three constants.

Publication

Htet, P. H. (2026). Duplicate leakage in a public conjunctival pallor benchmark, and an honest baseline for image-based anaemia screening. Preprint, Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22782147

Shows that a published clinical image dataset contains far fewer distinct images than records, that the duplicates carry conflicting labels, and that the usual site-grouped cross-validation does not remove the resulting inflation. Reports a corrected baseline and releases the detector.
